hotelRoles.title: Roles for this hotel
hotelRoles.description: Custom roles belong to this hotel. Built-in roles retain their fixed security rules.
hotelRoles.matrixNote: The matrix includes all five built-in roles and active custom roles. Owner and co_owner are shown read-only.
hotelRoles.templateHelp: The backend uses this template as the starting point; you can then adjust the role's permissions in the matrix.
hotelRoles.builtinImmutable: Built-in roles—including owner and co_owner—cannot be renamed or archived.
hotelRoles.archivePrompt: You are archiving “{{name}}” ({{assignedCount}} active users and {{invitationCount}} pending invitations). Both counts must be zero. Users and invitations are not removed automatically.
hotelRoles.unassignedOnly: This role has active users or pending invitations and cannot be archived.
hotelRoles.archiveBlocked: This role cannot be archived yet: {{assignedCount}} active users and {{invitationCount}} pending invitations. Manage assignments or invitations through their respective flows; nothing is removed automatically.
hotelRoles.archiveConflict: Could not archive: the server found active users or pending invitations for this role. Review the refreshed list and manage assignments or invitations through their respective flows.
hotelRoles.loadError: Could not load the role list.
hotelRoles.empty: There are no roles for this hotel yet.
hotelRoles.stale: This role changed after it was loaded. The list was refreshed; review it before trying again.
hotelRoles.assignmentBoundary: The owner role is managed through the ownership-transfer flow. Only the owner can assign co_owner.
hotelRoles.roleChangePermissionNotice: Changing a role removes individually granted permissions; individual restrictions remain in place.
hotelRoles.roleChangePermissionConfirm: Change the role to {{role}}? Individually granted permissions will be removed and restrictions will remain.
hotelRoles.latestInvitationLinkNotice: Each resend invalidates earlier links. Always use the link in the latest email.
hotelRoles.rolesError: Active roles could not be loaded. Invitations and role changes are disabled until the list is available.
hotelRoles.noAssignable: There are no active roles you can assign.
hotelRoles.customUserOverridesUnsupported: This interface does not yet display or edit individual overrides for custom roles.
hotelRoles.matrixContractMismatch: This custom role is active, but its matrix, profile, or visibility window is missing. The role remains read-only until the backend returns all three.
hotelRoles.protectedRoleReadOnly: {{role}} is protected and does not allow individual overrides.
hotelRoles.inactiveRoleReadOnly: {{role}} is archived or unavailable in this hotel; its overrides remain read-only.
hotelRoles.readOnlyRoleError: No change was applied: {{role}} does not allow overrides from this screen.
hotelRoles.roleUnavailable: The role could not be confirmed as active. No changes were applied.
hotelRoles.permissionConflict: This permission changed while you were editing. Data was refreshed; review it before trying again.
hotelRoles.permissionDenied: The server denied this change. No permission was applied.
hotelRoles.permissionSaveError: The change could not be saved.
